key.name: format
key.description: How uptime is displayed: "human" (for example "up 2 days, 4 hours") or "compact" (for example "2d 4h").

key.name: update-interval
key.description: Number of seconds between uptime refreshes. The preferences offer 30, 60 and 300 seconds.

key.name: show-icon
key.description: Whether to show a clock icon next to the uptime in the panel.
